raw_reconciliation.budget_recommendation: Use separate conditional generation-proxy and stress-overhead scenarios; only officially scoped Phase 1 plus setup timestamps would establish real official cost. Exclude independent verification, do not add tool latency already inside Agent time, and do not substitute Notebook wall time.

formula: T_total = T_setup + T_model + sum(T_i); T_i includes task setup, Agent/tool/model waits and patch collection within the official generation scope. Independent verification is excluded.
objective: Maximize sum_i P(resolved_i | B_i, task_i, policy) subject to the official total generation-time budget and correctness guardrails.
unknown_parameters: Private charge start/end and model-start boundary
Success probability as a function of budget/task
Cost tail and correlation of difficulty, runtime and success
Order and censoring from global expiry
Full-job timeout and partial-output scoring semantics
